review.tagline: Python library that builds LLM-driven scraping pipelines from a prompt and a URL
review.summary: ScrapeGraphAI is a Python library that extracts structured data from websites and local files (XML, HTML, JSON, Markdown) given a natural-language prompt. It provides graph pipelines such as SmartScraperGraph, SearchGraph and ScriptCreatorGraph, with multi-page variants that call the LLM in parallel. It works with OpenAI, Groq, Azure, Gemini, MiniMax or local models through Ollama, and uses Playwright to fetch pages.
review.audience: Python developers extracting structured web data with LLMs
strengths: Prompt plus URL returns a JSON dict; no per-site selectors to write
Runs against local Ollama models or hosted APIs by changing the llm config
Several pipelines: single page, multi-page, search results, Python script generation
Multi-page graph variants run LLM calls in parallel
weaknesses: Proxies, anti-bot handling and scaling are left to the user in the open-source version
Needs a separate `playwright install` step to fetch page content
Anonymous telemetry is on by default; opt out via SCRAPEGRAPHAI_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false
README steers users to the paid managed API for crawl and monitor features
needs: Needs Playwright, Ollama (for local models), LLM provider API key (for hosted models)
Models: Ollama, OpenAI, Groq, Azure, Gemini
